description: We are a team of third-year Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence students. Our toolkit is Python for data handling, relational databases, and the basics of machine learning; our habit is to ask where a number comes from before we use it. We are fast at learning unfamiliar domains, we document as we go, and we would rather ship one claim we can prove than ten we cannot. We join to learn from people who know the science better than we do, and to contribute the engineering and rigor around it.
